user.title: Beeper Desktop
user.description: Address of the Beeper Desktop API, for example http://192.168.1.50:23373, and an access token created in Beeper → Settings → Developers (read and write). Beeper Desktop must be running on that computer.

reauth_confirm.title: Beeper token refused
reauth_confirm.description: Beeper Desktop refused the access token. Create a new one in Beeper → Settings → Developers.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Beeper Desktop at that address. Is Beeper running and the computer on?

abort.already_configured: This Beeper Desktop is already configured.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Sends a text message to a Beeper chat.

chat.name: Chat
chat.description: Chat title as shown in Beeper, or its chat ID.
